references.text: Here the same command is given to strike the enemies with the ban and completely destroy them from the cities that the Lord gives Israel
The prohibition against making a covenant with the Canaanites and their gods, which would lead Israel into sin
The warning against making a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, as this would lead to idolatry
Explains that it was the Lord's will that these peoples should be hardened so they could be destroyed
Joshua's warning about the consequences of making covenants and marrying the remaining peoples
The warning that those who remain in the land will become thorns in their eyes and pricks in their sides for Israel
Israel broke the covenant by failing to destroy the peoples and by making covenants with them
Continuation of the command to destroy all the peoples without showing mercy
